content.comment_body: Hello everyone, At one of our production sites, we have a [product_name] on a UV insulator that is experiencing significant stability issues. The reference for this [product_name] is: [article_no]. It's an older device and does not have Ethernet capability. I am using [product_name] software [version_no], along with the [company_name] cable for front panel connection, which creates the COM3 port on the PC. I'm unable to connect to this [product_name] using the software, as it cannot detect the IP address. Any assistance would be greatly appreciated. Thank you to everyone in advance. Best regards, [user_name]

When beginning the transfer, a window appears allowing you to choose the connection type (Ethernet, [product_name] Cable, or dynamic DNS). Choose [product_name] Cable and ensure you select COM3 on the right. [IMAGE]
This older [product_name] needs to be manually set to transfer mode via its display. Refer to the attached [document] for guidance.

Hello [user_name], Thanks for your instructions—I managed to upload the program to my PC. Now I can modify it and deploy it to a newer [product_name] equipped with Ethernet. Appreciate the help, it's very helpful. See you soon.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered difficulties connecting to an older [product_name] model without Ethernet support. The main usability issue was confusion over selecting the correct communication method and configuring [product_name] software for non-Ethernet devices. Guidance for initiating transfers and placing the device in transfer mode was not immediately clear, especially with older hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expected [product_name] software to provide automatic or more explicit guidance when connecting to legacy [product_name] hardware without Ethernet, as well as simple, clear instructions for starting a successful transfer.
